objective: Find information missing from the R2 detector, especially morphology and spatial modulation, without using public test inputs for development.

representations.digital_morphology: Area, grid-edge perimeter and four-connected Euler characteristic at thresholds -1,0,1,2,3 after smoothing by 1,3,6 pixels: 45 features.
representations.regional: Mean offset, log-standard-deviation ratio, skewness and kurtosis in four longitudinal regions, at smoothing scales 0,3,6 pixels: 48 features.
representations.mask: Fixed survey mask, nonperiodic padded smoothing, fixed eroded supports. These are masked digital descriptors, not a reproduction of a continuum/unbiased Minkowski estimator.
representations.compact_models: Preserve the original 72 features; add train-only PCA coordinates: 16 morphology, 16 regional, or 8 from each. Fit three initialization seeds for each 88-dimensional conditional flow.

protocol.inputs: Official normal independent-realization training maps only; fixed R1 train/validation/calibration/audit splits.
protocol.pairing: Reproduce original normal and synthetic noise draws exactly; use original 72-feature caches as untouched leading coordinates.
protocol.density: Same R2 affine-coupling architecture, optimizer and 10000 updates; normal validation chooses checkpoints.
protocol.selection: Compare all previously used synthetic families and normal conditional false positives, report regressions as well as gains. These are reused development diagnostics, not an independent final OOD holdout.
protocol.public_test: No public test reads during this experiment. Candidates 04 and 05 remain frozen.
protocol.research_scope: Standalone JAX experiments on the authorized erdos-3242 lab machine; no production farm/job changes.

additional_ablation.name: Four shape-noise views for the original 72-feature flow
additional_ablation.control: Keep baseline normalization, architecture, optimizer schedule and all held-out inputs fixed; only the fitting examples receive extra noise draws.
additional_ablation.limitation: Repeated noise views are not independent simulator realizations.

followups_registered_after_initial_compa.reason: The four-view models still improved normal validation at 9750-10000 updates; regional features helped spatial modulation but diluted other shifts.

longer_noise_training.changes: Same four-view dataset and model; cosine schedule extended to 30000. Checkpoint selected on the same normal validation loss only.
longer_noise_training.selection: If a longer fit lowers normal validation NLL, select it per seed for the proposed noise-trained detector; do not select the budget on OOD diagnostic scores.

spatial_residual_control.hypothesis: Condition morphology/regional summaries on the original 72 normal summaries to separate additional information from global-scale variation.
spatial_residual_control.fitting: Ridge regression chosen by grouped-cosmology normal training CV; fixed 10% covariance shrinkage fitted on normal validation residuals. Compare per-map residual Mahalanobis distance.
spatial_residual_control.selection: Exploratory diagnostics only; no change to frozen candidates.
